_about: What the city take's model happened to write, remarked on where it is read (build_storyboard.py, REST_NOTES once use() points at the city take; "p<i>" after passage i, counted without the judges' letters). Rewritten for each retake. Take: build/rec_city3.
fight_2_end: One thing to watch: the first thrust breaks the wolf's backbone, and the backbone is where movement comes from. From then on the wolf has no points left to act with, and it never strikes back once. Where you hit matters.
p2: Provisioning frets about salt we do not even carry. A will sees the world through what it wants, and this one wants supplies, so it finds a shortage everywhere. Read it as the character's own anxious habit.
p4: Diligence is not one for celebrating: the success felt as unglamorous as the first steps of a new task. And note that nothing is bought yet. What the act secured is the meeting; the purchase is still a conversation away.
p12: Social Interaction asks which wares will still be on the shelf in five years. A strange question for a cobbler, and a very human one.
advice_proposing: My advice: dress for the people you deal with. Here the townsman's clothes alone gave four dice.
p14: Lighter than before: a good trade, felt in the body.
